links.outcome: Manual review of real GPT answers to site questions for helpfulness, completeness, and accuracy
links.effect: Of 588 GPT-answered questions, 13 (2%) not helpful, 12 (2%) incomplete, 5 (1%) misleading, 3 (1%) correct but with conflicting messaging.
links.quote: On manual review, of the 588 that the GPT reportedly answered, only 13 (2%) were not helpful responses, 12 (2%) were incomplete responses, 5 (1%) were misleading, and 3 (1%) contained the correct response but also provided some conflicting messaging.

unlisted_practices: Customized GPT for real-time trial protocol question answering for site coordinators

screen.reason: Empirical study describing the real-world deployment and evaluation (including coordinator survey and accuracy review) of a customized GPT assistant used by clinical trial coordinators to answer protocol questions.
